medical_laptop.notes: Bolted tabletop medical records laptop. 0.8m wide, 0.62m tall above table. Original laptop body, keyboard and medical/broken overlays. Source has no open/close mechanic. Separate lid and hinges retained for editing.

modular_computer.notes: One shared chassis for all 24 placed modular PCs. Program_Screen accepts original atlas overlays via material UV offset; see atlas_bindings.json. Powered/unpowered/broken visibility clips. For standby set screen state standby; powered restores selected program. No duplicate department bodies.

computer_frame.notes: Five construction states 0..4: empty, loose board, secured board/keyboard, wired, glassed. Anchored/unanchored uses the same geometry. Completion swaps to the built computer at runtime.

machine_frame.notes: Generic machine chassis, not computer frame. Orthographic sprite top region is a horizontal open roof; lower region is the vertical front electronics panel. Dimensions 1.68 x 0.84 x 1.26m. Three original box_0..2 stages; installed PCB lies horizontally below the rim. All opaque beams/panels have thickness and closed surfaces.

airlock_assembly.notes: 2m one-tile standard public airlock construction. Pixel-boundary silhouette, actual window apertures, solid/glass inserts, three original panel_c1..3 stages. Anchoring has no visual change. Completed door swaps to existing airlock model; assembly has no door-opening animation.
